title: Join Lines (J)
instruction_text:
Combine two lines into one!

'J' = join current line with the line below

Your task: Join 'Hello' and 'World' into one line.

Steps:
1. Move cursor to 'Hello' line (first line)
2. Press 'J' (capital J)
3. Vim automatically adds a space between words
4. Save and quit with :wq

Result: "Hello World" on one line
